name: Love Lesson
source:
When our guy asked a girl to be his girlfriend, he found out that she loves someone else. While drunk from depression, he made a mess of helping his new neighbor. It turned out that his new neighbor is his new homeroom teacher. What fun, now he can chase after his teacher or the girl that rejected him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
当我们的男人向一个女孩求婚时，他发现她爱上了别人。当他因抑郁而喝醉时，他把帮助新邻居的事情弄得一团糟。原来，他的新邻居就是他的新班主任。多有趣啊，现在他可以追他的老师或者那个拒绝他的女孩了。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
